sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 87.05% (cumulative volume USD 19.63M) and Lula at 12.50% (cumulative volume USD 22.27M), confirmed reading of 12/Oct, 15:00 BRT. Against the confirmed reading of 11/Oct at 17:33 BRT, published in the previous update, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 0.40pp and Lula holds steady; since the pair's sum went from 99.15 to 99.55, the normalized move is 0.05pp for each side. Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula goes from 74.15pp to 74.55pp. The contracts for the other names in the winner book have been closed since the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), resolved at zero.
sentimento.text2: 📊 THE SECOND-ROUND POLLS. The most recent national poll is DataTrends of 11/Oct: with 2,000 automated phone interviews from 07 to 09/Oct, Flávio Bolsonaro has 50% and Lula 44%, with 5% blank and spoiled ballots and 1% who don't know or didn't answer; in valid votes, 53.1% to 46.9% (Diário de São Paulo, GP1 and Poder360). On 10/Oct, Ipespe gave Flávio Bolsonaro 49% to 44%; on 09/Oct, AtlasIntel gave him 51.1% to 45.7% and Vox Brasil gave Lula 44.2% to 42.7%; on 08/Oct, Datafolha gave Flávio Bolsonaro 49% to 45% and PoderData/Aya 49% to 44%. Of the six national polls conducted after the vote, five put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead, by 4 to 6 points, and Vox Brasil puts Lula ahead by 1.5 points. On the night of 11/Oct, PoderData/Aya released the win-expectation breakdown from its 05 to 07/Oct wave: 54% think Flávio Bolsonaro will win the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) and 37% that Lula will win; in the 03/Oct wave, on the eve of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), the figures were 45% and 48% (CNN Brasil and Rádio Itatiaia). The voters of Augusto Cury, who declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct, go to him by 56% to 27% in PoderData/Aya and by 50% to 29% in Ipespe, and to Lula by 50.4% to 38.9% in AtlasIntel. Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, all three point to Flávio Bolsonaro. In the first round, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally of 05/Oct, with 100% of polling sections, Flávio Bolsonaro had 47.03% of the valid votes and Lula 45.16%. The week has 15 national polls registered with the TSE, the first full wave of the second round: 13/Oct (PoderData, Gerp, Nexus and 100 Cidades), 14/Oct ([Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest)), 15/Oct (Datafolha, AtlasIntel, Palver and Indexa) and 16/Oct (PoderData, Vox Brasil, MDA, 100 Cidades and Datavero).
sentimento.text3: 🤝 SECOND-ROUND ENDORSEMENTS. Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos and Augusto Cury, since 08/Oct, and of Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer; PSDB stayed neutral and released its members (Congresso em Foco and CartaCapital). Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1), and Renan Santos still backs no one (CNN Brasil and Estadão). On 12/Oct, Lula attended Mass at the chapel of the Palácio da Alvorada and said the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president cannot take sides (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo); the Senate scheduled for 14/Oct the vote on the constitutional amendment (PEC) to end the 6x1 work schedule, six days on and one off (CNN Brasil and Jovem Pan). On the 12/Oct holiday, Flávio Bolsonaro attended the Mass of Nossa Senhora Aparecida at the Brasília Cathedral and said he will visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro, on 13/Oct, after Alexandre de Moraes on Monday authorized the resumption of the visits, suspended since July, while barring the release of statements by the former president for political-electoral purposes (G1 and BBC News Brasil). ⚖️ On 11/Oct, the TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques, at the request of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, suspended the "Exército do Lula" channel on WhatsApp, and the inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) of the Electoral Justice, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, reinstated the channel that same afternoon. On 12/Oct, the TSE's advisory office for combating disinformation said in a report that it had not found on the channel, from 02 to 11/Oct, the false posts cited by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, but flagged risk from polarizing language and deleted messages, and Kassio summoned both campaigns to a meeting on 13/Oct (Estadão, Valor and UOL). Also on 11/Oct, Justice André Mendonça banned paid ads by Lula's campaign saying that Flávio Bolsonaro opposes ending the 6x1 schedule (UOL and Acesse Política). 🎙️ Record cancelled the 11/Oct debate, citing scheduling conflicts, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) has three debates scheduled: 15/Oct (SBT, RedeTV! and CNN Brasil), 18/Oct (Band) and 23/Oct (Globo), plus interviews with both candidates on Globo (Gazeta do Povo and Poder360).
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 87.05% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 19.63M), confirmed reading of 12/Oct, 15:00 BRT, up 0.40pp against the confirmed reading of 11/Oct at 17:33 BRT, published in the previous update. 📊 He has 50% to 44% in DataTrends of 11/Oct and leads five of the six national polls conducted after the vote; in Vox Brasil of 09/Oct he has 42.7% against 44.2%. In PoderData/Aya, 54% think he will win the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). On the 12/Oct holiday, Flávio Bolsonaro attended the Mass of Nossa Senhora Aparecida at the Brasília Cathedral and said he will visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro, on 13/Oct, after Alexandre de Moraes on Monday authorized the resumption of the visits, suspended since July, while barring the release of statements by the former president for political-electoral purposes (G1 and BBC News Brasil).
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 12.50% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 22.27M), confirmed reading of 12/Oct, 15:00 BRT, holds steady against the confirmed reading of 11/Oct at 17:33 BRT, published in the previous update. 📊 He has 44% against 50% in DataTrends of 11/Oct, and Vox Brasil of 09/Oct is the only national poll after the vote with him ahead, by 44.2% to 42.7%. On 12/Oct, Lula attended Mass at the chapel of the Palácio da Alvorada and said the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president cannot take sides (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo); the Senate scheduled for 14/Oct the vote on the constitutional amendment (PEC) to end the 6x1 work schedule, six days on and one off (CNN Brasil and Jovem Pan).
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 The names eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) added up to 7.81% of the valid votes. Augusto Cury (2.89%), Ronaldo Caiado (2.18%) and Romeu Zema (0.27%) declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro, and Renan Santos (2.24%) still backs no one. The voters of Augusto Cury, who declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct, go to him by 56% to 27% in PoderData/Aya and by 50% to 29% in Ipespe, and to Lula by 50.4% to 38.9% in AtlasIntel. Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, all three point to Flávio Bolsonaro. 🏆 Counting the closed contracts, the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book is still Lula's, USD 22.27M, ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro's, USD 19.63M, and Renan Santos's, which closed at USD 17.12M.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 12/Oct, 15:00 BRT (18:00 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. The contracts Polymarket closed after the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), those of the eliminated names and of the second-place, third-place and Senate books, drop out of the confirmation because they no longer have a traded price. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move comes the move normalized by the pair's sum, because the sum of prices moves on its own. The poll side of the divergence chart is the second-round Lula × Flávio Bolsonaro pair, in a single national poll and not the average, and always in the total vote: today it is DataTrends of 11/Oct, n=2,000, with 50% for Flávio Bolsonaro and 44% for Lula, the most recent national poll that published the total vote. The week has 15 national polls registered with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), the first full wave of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): 13/Oct (PoderData, Gerp, Nexus and 100 Cidades), 14/Oct ([Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest)), 15/Oct (Datafolha, AtlasIntel, Palver and Indexa) and 16/Oct (PoderData, Vox Brasil, MDA, 100 Cidades and Datavero).

inss.text1: 📺 In decisions released on 07/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, kept online videos from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign that associate Lula with Alexandre de Moraes and Lulinha with the so-called Careca do [INSS](/en/glossary#inss), and denied the Lula campaign's requests for removal and for a right of reply (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 🗳️ IN THE 04/Oct BALLOT COUNT, POLITICIANS LINKED TO THE INSS FRAUD WERE NOT RE-ELECTED, according to Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo, which note the contrast with those involved in the Master case, several of whom were elected. ⚖️ On 25/Sep Edson Fachin gave the Prosecutor General's Office five days to weigh in on the pending requests in the INSS and Master case investigations, among them requests to review or revoke detentions (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão); the deadline expired on 30/Sep, and the decision on the requests is his.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 ALSO ON 25/Sep, FOLHA DE S.PAULO REPORTS THAT THE DEFENCE OF A FORMER [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) PRESIDENT TURNED TO THE PRESIDENCY OF THE SUPREME COURT against a detention that has lasted more than 300 days; the act has a single source and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ The personal link between the INSS and the Master case recorded on 24/Sep remains the same: the plane Flávio Bolsonaro travelled on in 2025, linked to Daniel Vorcaro and to a lawyer under investigation in the INSS fraud case, and which the senator says belongs to a lawyer friend.
inss.impactoLula: This panel's approval benchmark is [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), and its 03/Oct round (BR-02197/2026) measures 44% approval against 49% disapproval. ⚠️ Palver of 03/Oct measures 43% against 56%, according to Exame. Pollsters ask in different ways, and the panel does not add one to another.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep, 44% against 50% on 21/Sep, 46% against 49% on 28/Sep and 44% against 49% on 03/Oct. Approval falls 2 points after two rounds of increase, within the margin of 2pp. ⭐ In the same round's assessment the negative is at 42%, the positive at 33% and the fair rating at 23% (Money Times). These are two different questions and they do not add up.
inss.conclusao: On 01/Oct Lula signed a legal opinion that guarantees victims of domestic violence up to six months of leave with pay covered by the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Valor). It is a benefit measure, not an act on the queue or on the investigation of the frauds. The five-day deadline that Edson Fachin opened on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to give its opinion on the pending requests in the INSS and Master case investigations expired on 30/Sep. In the polls, government approval ranges from 44.1% in Futura to 49% in Ideia among the national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct.

bancoMaster.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep THE FEDERAL PROSECUTION SERVICE'S SUPERIOR COUNCIL KEPT THE PROSECUTOR-GENERAL, PAULO GONET, ON THE MASTER CASE PROCEEDINGS AND SHELVED THE REQUEST TO INVESTIGATE HIS CONDUCT. Against his removal the vote was 9-0. On the inquiry, which stood at 4-3 in favour of opening it with two votes still to be cast, the result was 5-4 for shelving, and the last vote was cast by the council's vice-president, Nicolao Dino, who was chairing the session because the proceeding involved Gonet himself (G1, Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). The rapporteur, Francisco Sanseverino, pointed out that the messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone do not prove direct contact with the prosecutor-general, and the four defeated council members argued for appointing a deputy prosecutor-general to take the inquiry further, according to G1.
bancoMaster.text2: 📸 ESTADÃO, ON 25/Sep, AND VEJA, ON 26/Sep, REPORT THAT DANIEL VORCARO ATTENDED, ON JANUARY 31, 2024, A LUNCH HOSTED BY GRUPO ESFERA IN HONOR OF GONET, in Brasília, with about 40 guests, which Gilmar Mendes also attended. VEJA publishes the banker's message from that day: "I'll be at the Esfera lunch with Gonet. Gilmar should be there". Gonet says he had no friendship with Vorcaro, and the banker's defense says it rejects the selective disclosure of private conversations. 📅 The five-day deadline that Edson Fachin gave on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to weigh in on the pending requests in the case, among them those linked to the detentions of Henrique Vorcaro, Felipe Vorcaro, Fabiano Zettel and Daniel Lopes Monteiro, expired on 30/Sep.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ This page's price for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 3.15%, with cumulative volume USD 0.10M, confirmed reading of 12/Oct, 15:00 BRT, 0.20pp lower against the confirmed reading of 11/Oct at 17:33 BRT. AFOS does not attribute this contract's price to the news flow on the case: it measures the two side by side, with each one's timestamps. 📅 According to Estadão and Folha de S.Paulo on 08/Oct, Gabriel Galípolo reported to the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) unjustified delays by Central Bank staff in the supervision of Master, and Daniel Vorcaro's defence asked Edson Fachin to send his request for release to André Mendonça (O Globo, G1 and Estadão).
bancoMaster.conclusao: 🗳️ AT THE BALLOT BOX, THE CASE SPLIT: Estadão counts 13 politicians linked to Daniel Vorcaro elected on 04/Oct and notes the defeats of Ciro Nogueira and ACM Neto, and Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo note that people involved in the case were elected. The case moved on 25/Sep through two procedural acts, not decisions on the merits: the Federal Prosecution Service's Superior Council kept Paulo Gonet on the proceedings by 9 to 0 and shelved by 5 to 4 the request to investigate his conduct, and Edson Fachin asked the Prosecutor General's Office for an opinion within five days on the pending requests. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified; the ruling has been stalled since 15/Sep by Flávio Dino's request for further review. The request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided. ⚖️ On 02/Oct Edson Fachin created a rule to prevent requests from being directed to chosen justices (G1, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo) and requested a meeting with the director-general of the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) about the mentions of justices in the Master case (Gazeta do Povo and O Globo).

stf.toffoli: He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão released on 23/Sep, a survey separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. On 24/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he voted to remove an opponent of Davi Alcolumbre from the Amapá election and that André Mendonça interrupted the ruling; the act has a single source and is recorded here as attributed. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of the inquiry committee request by Alessandro Vieira.
stf.moraes: ⚖️ On 08/Oct, Alexandre de Moraes declared the final judgment (no further appeal) in the case against Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion in the course of proceedings and ordered the start of his 4 years and 2 months sentence in an initial semi-open regime, with his name in the national arrest warrant database, the cancellation of his passports and the suspension of his political rights (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo, Estadão and Valor). Eduardo Bolsonaro lives in the United States and called the decision arbitrary (Gazeta do Povo and VEJA), and Flávio Bolsonaro called on Moraes to resign (Estadão and O Globo). ⚖️ On 06/Oct he requested an opinion from the Office of the Prosecutor-General on Flávio Bolsonaro's new request to visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro (Gazeta do Povo and Poder360). The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro still has no date, suspended by a request for further review by Flávio Dino. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in that ruling so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified, and proposed internal inquiries; the account comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. On 25/Sep André Mendonça's filing on the report he used regarding that justice joined the list of pending requests that Edson Fachin sent to the Office of the Prosecutor-General, with a five day deadline. ⚖️ On the same day he was the rapporteur of the criminal case in which the Supreme Court convicted former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, 7-3, to one year of detention in an initially open regime for defamation against congresswoman Tabata Amaral.
stf.gilmar: 📺 On 01/Oct he ordered TV Globo to include Renan Santos in the presidential debate, at the request of Solidariedade, after Kassio Nunes Marques and Cármen Lúcia denied the candidate's requests; the broadcaster cancelled the debate the same night (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo). On 28/Sep, according to G1, he adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the Master case investigations are identified, and criticized André Mendonça's handling of the case; the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ On 24/Sep he took to the full bench of the Supreme Court a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts (precatórios) with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone showed interest in the vote of one justice in that case (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 📸 Estadão and VEJA report that he was at the Grupo Esfera lunch in honour of Paulo Gonet, on January 31, 2024, which Vorcaro attended, and on 26/Sep he publicly defended Gonet after the shelving (O Globo, Valor and Estadão).
stf.dino: ⚖️ On 27/Sep, in a single-justice ruling on a complaint, he overturned André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) that required deleting a post by comedian Antonio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida (Jovem Pan and Brasil 247), a decision that Luiz Fux suspended on the night of 28/Sep (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). After the TSE full court released Tabet's post on 30/Sep, on 01/Oct he declared the case moot and closed the action (Gazeta do Povo and Valor). On the same day Edson Fachin denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove him from the cases linked to the senator, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). On 15/Sep he requested more time to review the case in the trial on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes. On 02/Oct he publicly defended the rulings of the Supreme Court and the TSE on the TV Globo debate and Justice Estela Aranha (Folha de S.Paulo, Valor and Estadão).
stf.mendonca: His 76-page filing, submitted on 21/Sep, asks Edson Fachin for the summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority. On 25/Sep it joined the list of pending requests that Fachin sent to the Prosecutor General's Office, with a five-day deadline. On 24/Sep his office received Flávio Bolsonaro's request to investigate the relationship between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro, and on 25/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he keeps under seal the Master case proceeding in which he denied an operation against Cláudio Castro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution. 🗳️ Also on 25/Sep he ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint of Brazil (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo and CartaCapital), and in the criminal case against Eduardo Bolsonaro he voted for acquittal, outvoted along with Luiz Fux and Nunes Marques. ⚖️ On 30/Sep, at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) full court, he adjusted his vote to release Antonio Tabet's post and the cases of reasonable doubt, and the court upheld the removal of the posts that attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro the plan to strip the title of patron saint (Gazeta do Povo and G1).
stf.nexo: The link with the election is about the calendar and about institutions, not about the result, and there are two recent measurements of different questions, which do not add up. In the Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep, with fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep, 33% say the conduct of the Supreme Court justices hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy more and 23% say it hurts Lula's more (G1). In the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Bloomberg of 23/Sep, 52.3% say the crisis at the Supreme Court hurts Lula's candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's more. One question is about the conduct of the justices and the other about the crisis, and both pollsters surveyed the same week.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 3.15%, with cumulative volume USD 0.10M, confirmed reading of 12/Oct, 15:00 BRT, 0.20pp lower against the confirmed reading of 11/Oct at 17:33 BRT. The price remains far from the series high, 26.10% on 11/Sep. ⚖️ On 11/Oct, the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) president, Kassio Nunes Marques, at the request of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, suspended the "Exército do Lula" channel on WhatsApp, and the inspector general (Corregedor-Geral) of the Electoral Justice, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, reinstated the channel that same afternoon. On 12/Oct, the TSE's advisory office for combating disinformation said in a report that it had not found on the channel, from 02 to 11/Oct, the false posts cited by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, but flagged risk from polarizing language and deleted messages, and Kassio summoned both campaigns to a meeting on 13/Oct (Estadão, Valor and UOL). Also on 11/Oct, Justice André Mendonça banned paid ads by Lula's campaign saying that Flávio Bolsonaro opposes ending the 6x1 work schedule, six days on and one off (UOL and Acesse Política). ⚖️ On 12/Oct, Alexandre de Moraes authorized Flávio Bolsonaro to resume visits to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest, which had been suspended for 90 days since July, and barred the release of statements by the former president for political-electoral purposes (G1 and BBC News Brasil). On 08/Oct, he declared the final judgment (no further appeal) in the case against Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion in the course of proceedings and ordered the start of his 4 years and 2 months sentence in an initial semi-open regime (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo, Estadão and Valor). 🏛️ Folha de S.Paulo counts 50 elected senators in favour of impeaching Supreme Court justices, below the 54 votes required. ⛔ The panel does not link the contract's price to the day's acts: it measures both with each one's timestamp.
stf.fachin: 🏛️ Edson Fachin received on 06/Oct Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign coordinator, Rogério Marinho, and the Lula government's leader in the Senate (O Globo, CartaCapital and Estadão); Marinho said there will be no revenge against the Supreme Court, but that the Senate will not stand aside (Estadão, Gazeta do Povo and Metrópoles). ⚖️ ON 02/Oct HE CREATED a rule to prevent requests from being directed to chosen justices (G1, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo) and requested a meeting with the director-general of the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) about the mentions of justices in the Master case (Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). On 01/Oct he denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Flávio Dino from the cases linked to the senator, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). The five-day deadline he gave on 25/Sep for the Office of the Prosecutor-General to weigh in on the pending requests in the Master case and [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) investigations expired on 30/Sep, and since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pre-trial detention.
